title: AI Creative Director
intro: Your selected planner prepares the brief; your selected executor writes. The author decides what to keep.
modelPolicy: Uses existing AI settings. Providers never switch automatically.
max_calls: Maximum model calls for this task
budgetPolicy: A conservative local estimate requires configured prices and a supported output limit. Codex cost is unknown. This is not a provider bill.
approveContext: Review and approve this writing context before opening the director
important: I approve the important plot decisions
importantStep: This step requires author approval of a plot decision
reviewPolicy: Uses the existing literary reviewer. Covers the candidate and approved safe context, not all Canon. Reports are never forwarded automatically to Writer.
interveneHelp: Pause affects later scheduling. Stop cancels the current request and retains received text. Save new requirements, then explicitly continue.
instructionExample: Keep the first two paragraphs, then continue as a calm negotiation.
cancelCost: Stopping confirms local request handling. Upstream token charges may already exist. Requests are not retried automatically.
discardLocal: Discard unsaved local inputs? Saved tasks and background requests will remain.
cancelWaiting: Still waiting for the request to end. Local inputs remain available; save again later.
stopBeforeRewrite: Stop the current request before selecting a passage to rewrite.
selectDraft: Select a passage in the candidate draft and enter a new instruction.
saveBeforeContinue: Save edited drafts and requirements before continuing.
newStepInstruction: Continue the scene through concrete consequences of character choices.
briefHelp: Available after saving. Reads the approved safe context without a model call.
actualRequirements: Requirements delivered to the writing model
instructionBoundary: Use the current step; add an explicit condition in the brief if needed.
insufficientInputs: Partial input or not applicable to this step
noStyleEvidence: No confirmed profile supplied. Follow author intent and nearby prose without inventing a style profile.
briefPrivacy: Only approved Writer-view requirements are shown, without hidden reasoning or author secrets.
deferredOutcomes: Outcomes left for later (one per line)
pastReviewHelp: These sentences lack exact support in this input. They may be valid. Use the existing targeted review to investigate.
pastReviewNotError: These are low-certainty pointers, not factual verdicts or automatic edits.
localParameters: Saved with this task, separately for planning and writing; global preferences stay unchanged. Recheck supported parameters after changing a model.
externalChange: This record changed in another window or task. Your local edits remain; copy them before reopening the latest record.
savedLocal: Task draft and parameters saved locally; no manuscript adoption.
noHistory: No matching task. Enter a goal to prepare a local task draft.
elapsedBoundary: Time observed in this panel, not writing time or an estimate of time remaining
unsavedLocal: Local changes are unsaved. Save before executing or handing off.
candidateOnly: This console produces candidates. Adopt through the existing guarded Diff.
startHere: Start with a clear writing goal
startGoal: Enter a goal and choose Quick, Director or Deep mode.
startModels: Choose concrete models, supported effort and context budgets separately.
startConfirm: Prepare a local task, inspect the brief, then explicitly execute.
exported: Report exported. It includes the goal and candidate prose; check privacy before sharing.
handoffPrivacy: Python receives only your selected frozen candidate. Loading does not run code, call AI or read other tasks; other Actions retain their existing permissions.
completedPlan: All enabled steps are complete. Inspect the candidate/receipts, rewrite a selected passage, or edit and save further steps before continuing.
selectedStepBoundary: A single step appends to the candidate. It never runs other steps or rearranges existing prose.
customStepModel: Use independent model controls for this step
stepModelBoundary: Affects only this step. Review supported parameters and context budget after changing models. Inheritance does not change global settings.
forkBoundary: Copy this plan and model settings while retaining the original. Creating a copy is local only; execution still checks the manuscript revision and Writer approval.
forkContinueBoundary: Continue from current progress; completed steps are not automatically repeated.
forkFreshBoundary: Start the new attempt with an empty candidate and pending steps. The original remains available.
forkCreated: Independent attempt created locally. No model called; the original is retained.
analysisBoundary: Read-only analysis and actual output for author inspection. Never automatically sent to Writer context; not proof of literary or factual correctness.
analysisEmpty: No returned analysis. Hand a fixed candidate to Python, run it, then explicitly save the analysis record.
analysisStale: This analysis refers to an older candidate. Retain it as history; analyze the current version again.
analysisTruncated: Only the first 8,000 characters are shown here. Full output remains in the original Python run.
analysisRemoved: Task note removed. Original Python history retained.
noEnabledSteps: All steps are disabled. Enable or add a step and save before running; no model will be called now.
